dialogues.jp: 「さて、と。今日の昼飯は何にするか」
dialogues.en: "Come on! Pull yourself together! Let's go to another room."
dialogues.text: "Come on! Pull yourself together! Let's go to another room."

dialogues.jp:
んーと大きく伸びをしながら、これからのこと
を考える。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei pulls me by the sleeve.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei pulls me by the sleeve.

dialogues.jp:
例によって、杉並やら工藤やらと食堂にいくの
が妥当なところかな。
dialogues.en: "What about the class?"
dialogues.text: "What about the class?"

dialogues.jp: 「おーい、杉――」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. It'll only take 5 minutes."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. It'll only take 5 minutes."

dialogues.jp: と呼びかけた瞬間。
dialogues.en:
At the biology preparation room, I told her about what
happened yesterday.
dialogues.text:
At the biology preparation room, I told her about what
happened yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「せんぱ〜い、朝倉先輩」
dialogues.en:
"I wouldn't worry too much if it's only your sister that
found out."
dialogues.text:
"I wouldn't worry too much if it's only your sister that
found out."

dialogues.jp: み、美春？
dialogues.en: "She said she wouldn't tell anyone about it."
dialogues.text: "She said she wouldn't tell anyone about it."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「おーい、朝倉。｛・・・／わんこ｝が来てるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"I guess it was a mistake to put her coil spring in her
back. That makes it difficult to wind her up in public,
huh?"
dialogues.text:
"I guess it was a mistake to put her coil spring in her
back. That makes it difficult to wind her up in public,
huh?"

dialogues.jp:
ドアのところで、美春がぶんぶんと手を振って
いた。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei types something up on a computer keyboard and
looks at me.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei types something up on a computer keyboard and
looks at me.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、お昼一緒に食べましょう！」
dialogues.en:
"You've got to be more careful. You've got to remember, that
girl is Top Secret."
dialogues.text:
"You've got to be more careful. You've got to remember, that
girl is Top Secret."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え、ああ。今行く」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I understand."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I understand."

dialogues.jp: 席を立って、すたすたと入り口を目指す。
dialogues.en:
I wouldn't think anyone can find out about Miharu's true
identity. She looks like nothing but a human.
dialogues.text:
I wouldn't think anyone can find out about Miharu's true
identity. She looks like nothing but a human.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おい」
dialogues.en: People do believe that she's the real Miharu.
dialogues.text: People do believe that she's the real Miharu.

dialogues.jp: 杉並が小声で俺を呼び止める。
dialogues.en: Even her close friends can't tell.
dialogues.text: Even her close friends can't tell.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おまえ、いったい、いつから風紀委員に魂を
　売ったんだ？」
dialogues.en: It was after school.
dialogues.text: It was after school.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はあっ？」
dialogues.en:
I'd been taking Miharu home lately, so I didn't hang out
with my friends any more.
dialogues.text:
I'd been taking Miharu home lately, so I didn't hang out
with my friends any more.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「知っているぞ。わんこは料理が上手いんだろ。
　お手製の弁当ひとつで風紀委員に寝返るとは、
　恥を知れ、それでも同志か」
dialogues.en:
But I enjoyed being with Miharu. So there was nothing to
complain about.
dialogues.text:
But I enjoyed being with Miharu. So there was nothing to
complain about.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おまえと同志になった覚えはないぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, niisan. What are you smiling at? You're not thinking
of something nasty, are you?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, niisan. What are you smiling at? You're not thinking
of something nasty, are you?"

dialogues.jp:
オーバーリアクションで驚いている杉並をほっ
といて、美春の所に歩いていく。
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's you..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's you..."

dialogues.jp:
寝返ったわけではないが、美春の弁当はかなり
魅力的だ。
dialogues.en:
I turned around as I heard the voice behind me. It was Nemu,
standing there.
dialogues.text:
I turned around as I heard the voice behind me. It was Nemu,
standing there.

dialogues.jp:
以前、時々だが、美春はお手製のお弁当を持っ
てきて一緒に食べることがあった。
dialogues.en:
"Why me? Why don't you go buy it? You'll just watch TV at
home, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Why me? Why don't you go buy it? You'll just watch TV at
home, right?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並の言うとおり、美春の料理の腕前はかなり
のものだ。
dialogues.en:
My God! Doesn't she know how busy I am having to take Miharu
home?
dialogues.text:
My God! Doesn't she know how busy I am having to take Miharu
home?

dialogues.jp: 期待しないわけがない。
dialogues.en: But, I guess Nemu wouldn't care.
dialogues.text: But, I guess Nemu wouldn't care.

dialogues.jp: 「どこへ行く？　やっぱ中庭？」
dialogues.en: "All right. How about we decide by rock-paper-scissors?"
dialogues.text: "All right. How about we decide by rock-paper-scissors?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「中庭？　中庭が食堂なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Okay, sure!"
dialogues.text: "Okay, sure!"

dialogues.jp: 今日の美春は手ぶらだった。
dialogues.en: "Ready? Rock-paper-scissors!"
dialogues.text: "Ready? Rock-paper-scissors!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お弁当なんてないですよー」
dialogues.en: "Rock!"
dialogues.text: "Rock!"

dialogues.jp: 一瞬、気が遠くなりかける。
dialogues.en:
Heh heh... I played paper. I did mine after reading her
lips. I know it's a little tricky, but this is how you win
in the battlefield.
dialogues.text:
Heh heh... I played paper. I did mine after reading her
lips. I know it's a little tricky, but this is how you win
in the battlefield.

dialogues.jp: 「くそー。いつもならお重を作ってくるくせに」
dialogues.en: What?! -- Maybe not.
dialogues.text: What?! -- Maybe not.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……本物の美春さんは料理がとても上手だっ
　たと聞いていますが、美春は残念ながらそこ
　まではできません」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah! I won! I know exactly what you were thinking,
niisan."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah! I won! I know exactly what you were thinking,
niisan."

dialogues.jp:
まあ、言われてみれば、そのとおりだ。料理は
練習して、経験積んでなんぼだもんな。
dialogues.en: Nemu played scissors instead.
dialogues.text: Nemu played scissors instead.

dialogues.jp:
あくまで、この子は｛・・／美春｝ではないんだ。その実
感が湧いてきた。
dialogues.en: "God! What a sleazy trick!"
dialogues.text: "God! What a sleazy trick!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それに、食券を買ってみたくて」
dialogues.en: "Look who's talking. Have fun shopping!"
dialogues.text: "Look who's talking. Have fun shopping!"

dialogues.jp: 美春は嬉しそうに組んだ指をわきわきと動かす。
ボタンと見れば、何でも押したい年頃らしい。
dialogues.en: I completely lost the battle.
dialogues.text: I completely lost the battle.

dialogues.jp: 「わかった。じゃあ、行くか」
dialogues.en:
As I'm making my way to the biology preparation room to meet
Miharu, I'm comforting myself like a poor, defeated warrior.
dialogues.text:
As I'm making my way to the biology preparation room to meet
Miharu, I'm comforting myself like a poor, defeated warrior.

dialogues.jp:
ちょっとだけ、美春のうまいお手製弁当を期待
してしまったが、希望は｛はかな／儚｝くも露と消えた。
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sempai! Let's go home!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sempai! Let's go home!"

dialogues.jp: どきどきどきどき。
dialogues.en:
Well, now I didn't have to -- Miharu walked up to me
instead.
dialogues.text:
Well, now I didn't have to -- Miharu walked up to me
instead.

dialogues.jp: 「何やってんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hi, Nyamu-sempai! How's it going?"
dialogues.text: "Hi, Nyamu-sempai! How's it going?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、ちょっと指が震えて」
dialogues.en:
"Can you come with us to eat some chocolate bananas today?
Or maybe banana parfait."
dialogues.text:
"Can you come with us to eat some chocolate bananas today?
Or maybe banana parfait."

dialogues.jp: どきどきどきどき、どきどきどきどき。
dialogues.en: "With a friend?"
dialogues.text: "With a friend?"

dialogues.jp: 「お金使ったことないとか？」
dialogues.en: Nemu ran out of the classroom.
dialogues.text: Nemu ran out of the classroom.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうなんですよ。ほら、バスは定期だし」
dialogues.en:
"I was really hoping to eat chocolate bananas with
Nyamu-sempai today..."
dialogues.text:
"I was really hoping to eat chocolate bananas with
Nyamu-sempai today..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、俺が入れるよ。何食う？」
dialogues.en: Miharu's shoulders drooped.
dialogues.text: Miharu's shoulders drooped.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ダメーッ！　美春がやるんですってば！」
dialogues.en:
"I kind of feel abandoned. Is this some type of a new
sadistic technique?"
dialogues.text:
"I kind of feel abandoned. Is this some type of a new
sadistic technique?"

dialogues.jp:
財布を出そうとポケットに入れた手が、美春に
よって押さえつけられる。
dialogues.en: "Knock it off."
dialogues.text: "Knock it off."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ええと、この紙でいいんですよね？」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's only you and me then. Let's go."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's only you and me then. Let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「それは泣く子も黙る壱万円札だって。もっと
　細かいのないのか」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.jp:
ちらりと見ると、万札が一枚、二枚……。俺の
財布が全力を出しても勝ち目はない。
dialogues.en: "She sure did."
dialogues.text: "She sure did."

dialogues.jp: まさか、財力でロボットに負けるとは……。
dialogues.en:
I'm pretty positive because it was just a minute ago --after
I lost that battle with Nemu. A humiliating defeat for me--
how can I forget?
dialogues.text:
I'm pretty positive because it was just a minute ago --after
I lost that battle with Nemu. A humiliating defeat for me--
how can I forget?

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「これが、５００円玉で、こっちが１００円玉」
dialogues.en: "Nyamu-sempai is avoiding me, isn't she?"
dialogues.text: "Nyamu-sempai is avoiding me, isn't she?"

dialogues.jp: 確かめるように、財布から硬貨を取り出す美春。
dialogues.en: "No... Nemu wouldn't do such a thing."
dialogues.text: "No... Nemu wouldn't do such a thing."

dialogues.jp:
なんだか面白いな。お金を初めて見たヤツって
のはこういう行動を取るのか。
dialogues.en: Miharu chuckled while I was trying to make her feel better.
dialogues.text: Miharu chuckled while I was trying to make her feel better.

dialogues.jp:
「ほら、あまりもたもたしてると、後ろの連中
　が変に思うぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Miharu, look. Don't take this personally. Nemu still likes
you."
dialogues.text:
"Miharu, look. Don't take this personally. Nemu still likes
you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あー、えーと、じゃあ、これを入れますね」
dialogues.en: "Sempai."
dialogues.text: "Sempai."

dialogues.jp: 投入口に５００円玉が入る。
dialogues.en: Bending over, Miharu looks into my face with a smile.
dialogues.text: Bending over, Miharu looks into my face with a smile.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「すごい、一斉にランプが点きましたよ！」
dialogues.en:
"I understand how Nyamu-sempai feels, and I don't blame
her."
dialogues.text:
"I understand how Nyamu-sempai feels, and I don't blame
her."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いいから、早く食べたいものを選べよ」
dialogues.en:
"I rather feel terrible though, because I hurt
Nyamu-sempai's feelings."
dialogues.text:
"I rather feel terrible though, because I hurt
Nyamu-sempai's feelings."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: Miharu smiled, running her fingers through her loose hair.
dialogues.text: Miharu smiled, running her fingers through her loose hair.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: It'll certainly be hard for Nemu to forget that fact ----
dialogues.text: It'll certainly be hard for Nemu to forget that fact ----

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「バナナがないですね」
dialogues.en:
---- The fact that the person she thought was Miharu was
actually not her.
dialogues.text:
---- The fact that the person she thought was Miharu was
actually not her.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「バナナはご飯には入りません。ほら、きつね
　うどんでいいだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Come on, sempai! Don't give me such a sad look. Let's go
get some chocolate bananas!"
dialogues.text:
"Come on, sempai! Don't give me such a sad look. Let's go
get some chocolate bananas!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あーっ、そうやってまた勝手に押す！　先輩、
　ひどいですよぉ」
dialogues.en:
"Are you sure? Wow!! Let's see how many I want...... 50?
100?"
dialogues.text:
"Are you sure? Wow!! Let's see how many I want...... 50?
100?"

dialogues.jp: 券とお釣りが、ひらりと落ちてくる。
dialogues.en:
Hey, wait! That's way out of line. You aren't in a big eater
contest or anything.
dialogues.text:
Hey, wait! That's way out of line. You aren't in a big eater
contest or anything.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ううっ、美春の｛は／栄｝えある経済活動の第一歩が
　……」
dialogues.en: "Okay! I've changed my mind. It's on me up to five."
dialogues.text: "Okay! I've changed my mind. It's on me up to five."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「これからイヤってほど、体験できるよ」
dialogues.en: "Sempai, come on. Don't be so stingy."
dialogues.text: "Sempai, come on. Don't be so stingy."

dialogues.jp:
俺はそう言って、美春の頭をポフポフと叩きな
がら、自分は焼きそばの食券を買った。
dialogues.en: Miharu laughed, and so did I -- to dodge the situation.
dialogues.text: Miharu laughed, and so did I -- to dodge the situation.

dialogues.jp: それにしても、美春を見ていると、面白いな。
dialogues.en:
In the end, Miharu got 10 chocolate bananas, all of which I
paid for.
dialogues.text:
In the end, Miharu got 10 chocolate bananas, all of which I
paid for.

dialogues.jp: 簡単なことで感動したり、喜んだり。
dialogues.en: I sometime find it very difficult to be a real man.
dialogues.text: I sometime find it very difficult to be a real man.

dialogues.jp:
さっきも、食券を出しておばちゃんがうどんを
寄越してくれたのも、スゴイとか言ってたし。
dialogues.en: Especially when I'm broke.
dialogues.text: Especially when I'm broke.

dialogues.jp:
「今日が初めてってことは、昨日の昼はどうし
　たんだ？」
dialogues.en: At home Nemu was watching TV as usual.
dialogues.text: At home Nemu was watching TV as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「昨日は、白河先生と一緒に生物準備室で食べ
　ました。なんでも、妹さんに作ってもらった
　とかで」
dialogues.en: I tossed the trash out and put the kettle on.
dialogues.text: I tossed the trash out and put the kettle on.

dialogues.jp:
妹ってことは、ことりか……。そうか、料理も
できるのか。そういやずっと前、料理もプロ級
だって聞いたことあるな。
dialogues.en: "Want anything to drink?"
dialogues.text: "Want anything to drink?"

dialogues.jp:
うーむ、そう来たか。じゃあ、これからはずっ
とお昼は美春と一緒だな。
dialogues.en: I asked Nemu sitting on the sofa.
dialogues.text: I asked Nemu sitting on the sofa.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あら？　兄さん……と、美春？」
dialogues.en: "I want cafe au lait... with lots of sugar."
dialogues.text: "I want cafe au lait... with lots of sugar."

dialogues.jp: 友達と飯を食いに来た音夢が、声をかけてきた。
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 「よ、音夢」
dialogues.en: Then I put my coffee and her cafe au lait on the table.
dialogues.text: Then I put my coffee and her cafe au lait on the table.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「にゃむ先輩、こんにちはです」
dialogues.en: "Thanks."
dialogues.text: "Thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……だから、にゃむ先輩って誰よ」
dialogues.en: "This is good."
dialogues.text: "This is good."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、いえ、音夢先輩でした」
dialogues.en: "Glad you like it. I thought I put in too much sugar."
dialogues.text: "Glad you like it. I thought I put in too much sugar."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうしたの、ふたりで食事なんて。そんなに
　仲良かった？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan."
dialogues.text: "Niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、たまにはいいだろってことでさ。それ
　に結構、仲はよかったぞ？　な、美春」
dialogues.en:
"About what happened after school today... I was avoiding
Miharu, though I didn't mean to..."
dialogues.text:
"About what happened after school today... I was avoiding
Miharu, though I didn't mean to..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そういうことになってますね」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　そういうことになっている？」
dialogues.en:
"I'm confused. I honestly don't know how I can see her like
before."
dialogues.text:
"I'm confused. I honestly don't know how I can see her like
before."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の頭の上に“？”マークが飛び交う。
dialogues.en:
Nemu muttered under her breath, while clouding her face with
steam coming off her cup.
dialogues.text:
Nemu muttered under her breath, while clouding her face with
steam coming off her cup.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、いいけど。それより、また今度お弁当
　を作ってきて。美春のお弁当おいしいから」
dialogues.en: "I guess she already noticed it, right?"
dialogues.text: "I guess she already noticed it, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい！」
dialogues.en:
I didn't respond right away. But I decided to tell her the
truth.
dialogues.text:
I didn't respond right away. But I decided to tell her the
truth.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ありがと」
dialogues.en: "Did she say that?"
dialogues.text: "Did she say that?"

dialogues.jp: おいおい。安請け合いしていいのか？
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 一抹の不安が胸中をよぎる。
dialogues.en:
On the TV, the reporter was laughing hard. It was quite
funny to see the reporter talk with a female middle-age shop
owner.
dialogues.text:
On the TV, the reporter was laughing hard. It was quite
funny to see the reporter talk with a female middle-age shop
owner.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が立ち去った後、つるつると美春がうどん
をすする音だけが聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en: Nemu said quite sadly.
dialogues.text: Nemu said quite sadly.

dialogues.jp:
「やっぱ、身内は手強いな……クラスの友達の
　ほうは大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about it. Miharu didn't take it personally."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about it. Miharu didn't take it personally."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい。マターリとやってます」
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「マターリ……って、なんだよ、それ」
dialogues.en:
While tilting her cup, Nemu slowly nodded. Her eyes looked
as if they were about to cry.
dialogues.text:
While tilting her cup, Nemu slowly nodded. Her eyes looked
as if they were about to cry.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いやぁ、できるかぎり社会の情報を集めよう
　と思いまして、ネットの海へ潜ってたんです
　が、ちょいとそこで覚えまして」
dialogues.en: "Do you really like the cafe au lait?"
dialogues.text: "Do you really like the cafe au lait?"

dialogues.jp:
なるほど。美春は美春で、早く実生活に溶けこ
もうと前向きに努力してるんだな。
dialogues.en:
She replied absent-mindedly. On TV, a B-list TV personality
is reporting on a popular noodle shop.
dialogues.text:
She replied absent-mindedly. On TV, a B-list TV personality
is reporting on a popular noodle shop.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、言葉の意味は分からんが……」
dialogues.en: "Do you want a ramen noodles delivery tonight?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want a ramen noodles delivery tonight?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ところで、朝倉先輩は、お弁当は何が食べた
　いですか？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp:
うどんをちゅるんと飲み込んで、いとも簡単そ
うに、美春が｛き／訊｝く。

「……いや、料理なんてそう簡単にできるよう
　になるもんじゃないぞ？」
dialogues.en: Like talking to a brick wall...
dialogues.text: Like talking to a brick wall...

dialogues.jp:
俺はそれをイヤというほど実感している。地獄
の殺人シェフのおかげで。
dialogues.en: "Are you busy with your committee?"
dialogues.text: "Are you busy with your committee?"

dialogues.jp: 英語で言うと、マーダラーシェフオブヘルズ。
dialogues.en: "How did the exam go?"
dialogues.text: "How did the exam go?"

dialogues.jp: いや、シェフはフランス語か……。
dialogues.en: "What color panties are you wearing today?"
dialogues.text: "What color panties are you wearing today?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、本物の美春さんは、料理が上手だった
　んですよね？」
dialogues.en: "Leopard print..."
dialogues.text: "Leopard print..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春は美春だろ。美春のことは気にするな」
dialogues.en: "Wow! Really?"
dialogues.text: "Wow! Really?"

dialogues.jp:
……自分で何言ってんだかわからない台詞だな。
ちょっと、恥ずかしかったりして。
dialogues.en: Good. Nemu is back to normal.
dialogues.text: Good. Nemu is back to normal.

dialogues.jp: ちらりと、美春の顔を窺う。
dialogues.en: "God, you were listening!"
dialogues.text: "God, you were listening!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あはは。うどんって楽しいですねえ。ちゅる
　ちゅるとおつゆが跳ねて」
dialogues.en:
"Of course I was! How long do you think I've been your
sister?"
dialogues.text:
"Of course I was! How long do you think I've been your
sister?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「聞いちゃいねえし。……しかも、飛ばしてる
　よ」
dialogues.en: Nemu looked away and sipped more from her cup.
dialogues.text: Nemu looked away and sipped more from her cup.

dialogues.jp:
ふと気がつけば、テーブルがうどんのつゆで汚
れまくっていた。
dialogues.en: "What? Call where?"
dialogues.text: "What? Call where?"

dialogues.jp: 「美春、後でちゃんと拭いておけよな」
dialogues.en: Emptying her cup, Nemu stood up from the sofa.
dialogues.text: Emptying her cup, Nemu stood up from the sofa.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「は〜い」
dialogues.en:
"Delivery for eel rice! Right? Meals with eels take time,
you know?"
dialogues.text:
"Delivery for eel rice! Right? Meals with eels take time,
you know?"

dialogues.jp:
何が楽しいのやら、にこにこと元気に返事をす
る美春だった。
◆うどん◆
dialogues.en: ◆Koyomi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Koyomi◆

dialogues.jp:
美春と学食で昼飯を食べる。本当は美春お手製
の弁当を期待していたのだが、ロボ美春は料理
ができないらしい。
dialogues.en: I told Koyomi-sensei about Nemu after the morning class.
dialogues.text: I told Koyomi-sensei about Nemu after the morning class.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、それもそうか。改めてこの子は美春では
ないんだなと実感するのであった。
dialogues.en: She sighed deeply and sadly.
dialogues.text: She sighed deeply and sadly.
